I recently went for a Korean facial at Lakme Salon, Powai. My therapist, Ms Tina, was good — she was gentle, professional, and handled the session nicely.
However, I was slightly disappointed with the explanation given prior to the treatment by 'manager'. I was informed that the Korean facial is a “supreme” facial that covers everything needed, and that there wouldn’t be any additional add-ons required. But during the session, I was advised to add a mask for tanning.
I initially understood the mask to be ₹300, but later realized it was actually ₹1300. The Korean facial itself was ₹7500, and with the add-on, the total came up to ₹8800. I feel the pricing and add-ons should have been explained more clearly upfront to avoid confusion.
Overall, the service by Ms Tina was good, but I do think transparency in pricing and clearer communication would make the experience much better. As for whether it was worth ₹8800 — that’s still a little questionable
